description: This file defines a React-based document rendering system with types, default renderers, and a main DocumentRenderer component for rendering structured document nodes.

methods.name: DocumentNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a document node based on its type, applying appropriate renderers and handling child nodes.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Recursively sets a value in an object at a specified property path.

methods.description: Creates props for a component block by merging node properties and children.

methods.name: DocumentRenderer
methods.description: Main React component that renders a list of document nodes using specified or default renderers and component blocks.
